topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Rain's been drumming on the roof all morning, steady as a heartbeat. Jane from next door knocked on my door, umbrella dripping on my threshold. Asked if she could use a patch of my yard for a garden. "Sure," I say, voice flat. "Why not?" I've got more yard than I know what to do with, but there's something about the way she looks, hopeful, that makes the inside of my chest feel heavy. I hand her a key. "Take what you need," I tell her. Watch her go, thinking about how sometimes, the only thing to do is let people plant their roots where they can.
